# Best Enterprise Data Platforms for Large Companies

## Cloud-Based Data Warehouses/Lakehouse Platforms

| Platform | Strengths | Best For |
|----------|-----------|----------|
| **Snowflake** | Scalability, multi-cloud support | Analytics, data sharing |
| **Databricks** | ML/AI workloads, Delta Lake | Data science, streaming |
| **Google BigQuery** | Serverless, strong SQL | Analytics at scale |
| **Amazon Redshift** | AWS ecosystem integration | AWS-heavy orgs |
| **Azure Synapse** | Microsoft integration | Microsoft shops |

## Traditional Enterprise Data Warehouses

- **Teradata** - High-performance analytics
- **IBM Db2** - Reliable, enterprise-grade
- **Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse** - Strong for Oracle ecosystems
- **SAP HANA** - Real-time analytics, SAP integration

## Data Integration & Management

- **Informatica** - Data governance, quality
- **Talend** - Open-source friendly integration
- **MuleSoft** - API-led connectivity
- **dbt** - Data transformation

## Key Considerations When Choosing

- **Existing tech stack** compatibility
- **Data volume** and growth projections
- **Security & compliance** requirements
- **Budget** (licensing vs. consumption-based)
- **Team skills** and expertise
- **Real-time vs. batch** processing needs
- **Vendor lock-in** risk

## Current Market Leaders
Snowflake and Databricks are widely considered the **top modern choices** for large enterprises.
